regions.label: The Delta Coast
regions.terrain: coastal tidewater — estuary, levees, shotgun porches

regions.label: The Amplified Range
regions.terrain: high mountains — basalt cliffs, feedback storms

regions.label: The Steel Foothills
regions.terrain: foothills - slide scarps, steel terraces, bottleneck switchbacks

regions.label: The Heartland
regions.terrain: farmland plains — wheat, gravel roads, grain towers

regions.label: Second Line Riverlands
regions.terrain: riverside port — wharves, brass balconies, paddle steam

regions.label: The Quiet Woods
regions.terrain: forest and lakes — pine shade, cabin lights, still water

regions.label: The Outer Isles
regions.terrain: offshore archipelago continuing the range's line north - ferry weather, distant genres

waterways.label: The Big Muddy
waterways.note: rises where the massif meets the north coast, runs the range's southwest slope past the Steel Foothills, and spills into the sheltered bay

waterways.label: Slowhand Creek
waterways.note: rises from a forest lake in the Quiet Woods and joins the Big Muddy above the foothill reach

waterways.label: The Wide Water
waterways.note: the southern sea; the sheltered bay opens off it at the Big Muddy mouth

waterways.label: The North Reach
waterways.note: the northern sea; the massif runs to its shore and the Outer Isles continue the range line offshore

waterways.label: The Chainwater Sound
waterways.note: the north sea's central inroad; a short coastal range (the Chain) holds its south shore

waterways.label: The West Water
waterways.note: fjord coast off the Quiet Woods; ragged fingers, no settlements

waterways.label: The East Shore
waterways.note: eastern shore below the massif's cape; the range is a coastal cordillera
